title: Chapter 185: High-Profile Entry Into The World
content:
Chapter 185: High-Profile Entry Into The World

When night fell, the core combat arms of the Zerg withdrew from the underground world to the Zerg territory. The ground troops drilled underground to recover, and the air troops landed on the fungal blanket to speed up the recovery.

They had to recover to their best condition as soon as possible to guard against possible wars at night.

The day's battle came to an end, and Wu Qing started his night work again.

In terms of the accumulation of Zerg forces, Wu Qing consumed the gas resources obtained from the two battles today on dragons and cockroaches.

He increased the number of Zerg dragons to , which will soon catch up with hydralisks. You should know that hatching a dragon consumes four times the gas resources of a hydralisk, which shows how much consumption is. From this, we can see that Wu Qing attaches great importance to dragons.

The performance of Zerg dragons in the underground world is somewhat unsatisfactory, mainly because the space in the underground world limits their performance.

If they were in the outside world, the sky is high and the land is far away, and they are allowed to fly, their official appearance will definitely shock the world.

Up to now, Wu Qing has not seen a formal flying arm, which shows that flying arms are rare in this world.

A Zerg dragon, placed in the outside world, is a powerful force.

For the remaining Qi resources, Wu Qing chose to increase the number of cockroaches to 5,000, and then replenish the 1,000 explosive mosquitoes consumed in the Naga territory.

With 5,000 cockroaches and dogs to fight in close combat, the Zerg can fight some technical close combat, and no longer need to rely on Zerg dogs to fight for their lives.

With the strong support of stealth spiders, hydralisks and destroyers, the Zerg finally has a lineup that can be shown on the front battlefield.

The Zerg's current air force has an absolute air advantage over the surrounding enemies, and can be used flexibly. It is a good choice to use it in the front battlefield, surprise attack, and single combat.

Wu Qing allocated the precious Qi resources well, and he did not need to plan the use of energy resources in detail. He first sent out dogs to replenish the number of dogs consumed on the battlefield today. Tomorrow, the third batch of Zerg reinforcements will go to the Naga territory.

Wu Qing needs to think about tomorrow's reinforcement lineup and see if he should adjust it and send a large army that can fight alone.

Except for special troops like the Queen who need to be hidden, the new Zerg troops will be used on the battlefield to counterattack the evil god camp, so there is no problem of confidentiality.

You can go to the battlefield openly to show the strength of the Zerg.

...

Wu Qing arranged the work of the Zerg territory. Seeing that the Zerg underground territory was as calm as ever, he put his mind on the ten teams of Zerg Knights who set out this morning.

These ten teams of Zerg Knights went out with important tasks. They wanted to promote the reputation of the Zerg, spread the Nine Changes of the Silkworm, and plant chess pieces everywhere. They must act in a high-profile manner and take the initiative to get involved in things!

These Zerg Knights, when they go out, will make some things happen even if they have nothing to do. They must take care of things when they encounter them. First, establish a set of personality labels, so that it is easy to promote your reputation and let others remember you.

Adhering to this idea, Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects designed uniform armor and weapons for them.

The black full-body armor, bright red cloak, and a single sword in the style of a Tang sword look mighty and domineering, with extraordinary momentum, yet simple and neat.

In a prominent position on the left chest armor, there is a three-dimensional realistic silkworm pattern, which looks crystal clear and vivid.

Below the silkworm pattern, the four big characters "Zerg Silkworm" are written in the language of this world.

This design should allow people to see the four big characters of Zerg Silkworm at a glance, and also know the true appearance of the Zerg Silkworm.

The template of this set of equipment is stored in the biological colonization template library of the data center by the Queen of Insects, and the Zerg Knight can directly use the biological colonization to call and change it.

In the future, the Zerg Knights walking outside will be dressed in this outfit, plus a Zerg warhorse, which is their standard configuration.

With such obvious characteristics, as long as these Zerg Knights do something outside, it is difficult for people to forget it.

This is the effect Wu Qing wants.

Wu Qing first checked the images recorded by the ten teams of insect knights along the way through the Queen of Insects. Under the influence of Wu Qing, the Queen of Insects gradually developed functions similar to biological intelligent brains, which greatly facilitated Wu Qing.

The ten teams of insects had similar experiences. Once they left the territory controlled by the Zerg, they truly experienced the feeling of walking in the wild in the daytime in this world.

The army was dispatched, all things retreated, and the Zerg puppies were scouting, either secretly or fiercely abnormal, which was not a normal experience of walking in the wild.

It was also the first time that Wu Qing looked at this world from this perspective.

The insect knights walked in the form of normal humans, and did not deliberately release the fierce momentum of the Zerg. All kinds of bulls, snakes, ghosts and gods emerged.

For ordinary people, the biggest danger is various predatory animals. Wu Qing has not seen extraordinary animals such as fierce beasts, demon beasts, and monsters in this world for the time being. All he has seen are humanized or anthropomorphic races.

Although these races have some animal characteristics, they are no longer the same species, just like humans and gorillas.

They may get close to animals with the same characteristics, but they will not regard animals as their own kind.

These animals living in nature are nourished by the spiritual energy of this world, and their size and strength have improved a little, but they are just ordinary animals after all.

Wu Qing does not know whether there are more powerful animals in other parts of this world.

Ordinary people walking outside during the day are most likely to encounter predatory animals that roam everywhere. If they find that ordinary people are weaker than them, they are likely to attack.

For ordinary people, small things such as snakes, insects, rats and ants are also deadly dangers.

There are also some poisonous plants, special environments, natural phenomena, etc. In this primitive ecological environment, there are hidden dangers everywhere.

These are normal dangers in nature, and they also exist in other worlds.

The difference is that this world does have some special weirdness, which can appear during the day under special circumstances. This is the most terrifying existence for ordinary people.

The strength of these weirdness is not very strong, but the weirdness is unpredictable. Ordinary people can't deal with it at all. There is almost no possibility of survival if they encounter it.

In addition to these dangers, there is another kind of danger from intelligent creatures themselves.

In the wild during the day, you will also encounter some strange races. These people have very complicated identities. Some are scouts of the territory, some are spies of the evil god camp, some are refugees, and some are bandits who kill and rob. There are all kinds of people.

There are still so many dangers lurking in the wild during the day. Without a certain level of strength, you can't go far in the wild.

The insect knights are so high-profile that even if there are only ten of them, no matter whether they are intelligent creatures or predatory animals, they dare not take the initiative to provoke them.

The insect knights also take the initiative to contact people of various races they meet in the wild. Most people run away as if they have seen ghosts. Only the scouts from nearby territories will respectfully say a few words to them.

Running all the way, the ten teams of insect knights rushed to different directions. They only recorded the small territories they passed by without stopping. These small territories are small slave societies, and there is no need to disturb them.

Their target is those large cities with basic normal social forms.

These large cities have a large population. Although their social forms are diverse, their essence is not much different, which is similar to the different stages of human development that Wu Qing knows.

This area is mainly the sphere of influence of the Tengu and Naga tribes. All large cities are basically built by the two major tribes.

Five teams of insect knights headed east to find the big city of the Tengu tribe, and five teams of insect knights headed north to find the big city of the Naga tribe.

Although there was a map bought from the goblin merchant Gong Zhe, the map was very simple and the description was not clear. One of the tasks of the insect knight team was to improve this map.

After a day of running, in the end, only one team of insect knights found a big city, and this was found by relying on a chess piece of the Tengu tribe that Wu Qing had buried before.

On the battlefield where Wu Qing provoked the Tengu tribe and the Bear Goblin tribe to start a camp war in advance, the Tengu cavalry guide who had been with him was sent by the Tengu cavalry general who was finally killed by the Zerg to die with the Zerg army.

Such a person who was excluded in the Tengu tribe and was about to be killed on the battlefield by a general using his power, Wu Qing was concerned at the time.

So he was always with him, protecting him well, and finally gave him a set of powerful biological colonization suits of the Zerg guards, so that he could return with the credit of guiding the Zerg army to attack the enemy's vital points.

Wu Qing didn't tell him anything, but just let him bind the biological colonization suit, saying it was a reward for his guidance.

According to the information provided by the Queen of Zerg, without this powerful biological colonization suit, the guide would have died many times.

The biological colonization suit is the life of the Zerg, and it can collect information around the binder as long as it is needed.

The experience of this Tengu cavalryman named Gou Shu is like a dog-blood drama. The plot seems to be ups and downs, but it is actually very simple to say.

He was originally a young hero of the Tengu tribe. He joined the cavalry unit of the tribe very early, and his future prospects were limitless.

Unfortunately, fate played a joke on him. The marriage partner chosen by his family for him was a little special. The younger generation of a great elder in the tribe learned about it and wanted to get it to the mansion.

It was not nice to tell others about this matter of stealing someone's fiancée. To save face, the powerful son had no choice but to let Gou Shu die.

If he died, others could find a reason to take his fiancée away openly without any gossip.

Due to their different status, someone told him to die on the battlefield with just one word. He changed his attitude from the cavalry general and realized that there was a problem, but he didn't know where the problem was.
